2125384095123554304.en_summary: firesidealpha reports Joe Rogan watched a SpaceX launch with Elon Musk from the command center, saying rockets explode because SpaceX pushes them to the limit on purpose to find weak points. Quoted Musk on recruiting first engineers by saying they would probably die, and becoming chief engineer as no good one would join, starting SpaceX in 2002 expecting 90% chance of failure.
2125384095123554304.zh_summary: firesidealpha 報道 Joe Rogan 與 Elon Musk 在指揮中心觀看 SpaceX 發射，稱火箭爆炸是因為 SpaceX 故意將其推至極限以找出弱點。引用 Musk 表示招募首批工程師時告知他們可能會死，並因無人願意加入而成為首席工程師，2002 年創立 SpaceX 時預期有 90% 失敗機率。

2125383316828205431.en_summary: Post states Say’s law for AI: AI exposes cybersecurity vulnerabilities creating demand for AI models to guard against them. Quoted The Information reporting OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar says estimates of cybersecurity market above $300 billion underestimate potential, and Brockman says no question cyber will become bigger business than coding, though unclear how OpenAI scales against Anthropic.
2125383316828205431.zh_summary: 帖文提出 AI 的薩伊定律：AI 暴露網絡安全漏洞，從而創造對 AI 模型防禦這些風險的巨大需求。引用 The Information 報道 OpenAI 財務長 Sarah Friar 稱網絡安全市場超過 3000 億美元的估計遠低估潛力，Brockman 表示網絡安全無疑將成為比編碼更大的業務，但 OpenAI 如何對抗 Anthropic 擴大規模尚不明確。

2125382179186516117.en_summary: 3PeaksTrading notes large MOC buy imbalance today was intriguing and pivotal. Quoted VolSignals expecting VIX to test then lose 25 level, head to 19-20, testing new highs before FOMC, possibly 7700 by end of next week.
2125382179186516117.zh_summary: 3PeaksTrading 指出今日大型 MOC 買盤失衡引人注目且關鍵。引用 VolSignals 預期 VIX 將測試然後跌破 25 水平，快速前往 19-20，並在 FOMC 前測試新高，下週末可能見 7700。

2125381955244155120.en_summary: 3PeaksTrading replies that SPX had only an 85 point range today, well below current ATR, perhaps a collective sigh of relief from vol sellers.
2125381955244155120.zh_summary: 3PeaksTrading 回覆稱今日 SPX 僅有 85 點波幅，遠低於當前 ATR，可能是波動率賣方集體鬆一口氣。

2125381427848163766.en_summary: 3PeaksTrading states market model risk regime still in 'Defensive' mode as 3 of 4 red flags persist. VIX inverted is key not to ignore, but can change fastest if vol crush comes.
2125381427848163766.zh_summary: 3PeaksTrading 表示市場模型風險制度仍處於「防禦」模式，因 4 個紅旗中有 3 個持續。VIX 倒掛是不可忽視的關鍵，但若波動率崩潰來臠時可最快改變。
